mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, spu_id, created_at FROM user_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND spu_id = #{spuId}
SELECT id, user_id, spu_id, created_at FROM user_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT uf.spu_id, p.name, c.name AS category_name, p.main_image_url, COALESCE( MIN(CASE WHEN p.status = 'on_sale' AND s.status = 'on_sale' AND COALESCE(i.available_stock, 0) > 0 THEN s.sale_price END), MIN(s.sale_price) ) AS sale_price, CASE WHEN p.status = 'on_sale' AND COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'on_sale' AND COALESCE(i.available_stock, 0) > 0 THEN i.available_stock ELSE 0 END), 0) > 0 THEN 'available' ELSE 'unavailable' END AS availability_status, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'on_sale' AND s.status = 'on_sale' AND COALESCE(i.available_stock, 0) > 0 THEN i.available_stock ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_available_stock FROM user_favorite uf JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = uf.spu_id JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON s.spu_id = p.id LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.sku_id = s.id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY uf.id, uf.spu_id, uf.created_at, p.id, p.status, p.name, c.name, p.main_image_url ORDER BY uf.created_at DESC, uf.id DESC
